_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "businesses" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "gstin" TEXT NOT NULL, "pan" TEXT NULL, "business_type" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "address" TEXT NOT NULL, "city" TEXT NOT NULL, "state_code" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pincode" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "logo_path" TEXT NULL, "bank_name" TEXT NULL, "bank_account" TEXT NULL, "bank_ifsc" TEXT NULL, "upi_id" TEXT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "invoice_template" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CLASSIC', "quote_template" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CLASSIC', "invoice_series_format" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INV-{FY}-{SEQ4}', "quote_series_format" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'QT-{FY}-{SEQ4}', "credit_note_series_format" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CN-{FY}-{SEQ4}', "debit_note_series_format" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DN-{FY}-{SEQ4}', "default_invoice_template_id" INTEGER NULL, "default_quote_template_id" INTEGER NULL, "brand_color" INTEGER NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "business_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES businesses (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "gstin" TEXT NULL, "pan" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "city" TEXT NULL, "state_code" INTEGER NULL, "pincode" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "business_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES businesses (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "hsn_sac" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_price" REAL NOT NULL, "purchase_price" REAL NULL, "gst_rate" REAL NOT NULL, "cess_rate" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "stock_quantity" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "reorder_level" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "is_service" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_service" IN (0, 1)), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "invoices" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "business_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES businesses (id), "customer_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "invoice_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "invoice_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "invoice_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "supply_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "place_of_supply" INTEGER NOT NULL, "subtotal" REAL NOT NULL, "discount_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "taxable_amount" REAL NOT NULL, "cgst_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "sgst_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "igst_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "cess_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "total_amount" REAL NOT NULL, "round_off_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "amount_paid" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "amount_in_words" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "terms" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT', "is_igst" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_igst" IN (0, 1)), "template_id" INTEGER NULL, "reference_invoice_id" INTEGER NULL, "reverse_charge" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reverse_charge" IN (0, 1)), "ship_to_name" TEXT NULL, "ship_to_address" TEXT NULL, "ship_to_city" TEXT NULL, "export_with_lut" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("export_with_lut" IN (0, 1)), "tds_section" TEXT NULL, "tds_rate" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "tds_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "tcs_section" TEXT NULL, "tcs_rate" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "tcs_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("business_id", "invoice_number"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "invoice_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "invoice_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "product_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES products (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "hsn_sac" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "rate" REAL NOT NULL, "discount_pct" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "taxable_amount" REAL NOT NULL, "gst_rate" REAL NOT NULL, "cgst_rate" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "sgst_rate" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "igst_rate" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "cess_rate" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "cgst_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "sgst_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "igst_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "cess_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "total_amount" REAL NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "invoice_payments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "invoice_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PAYMENT', "paid_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NULL, "reference" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_activity_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "business_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES businesses (id), "customer_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NULL, "entity_id" INTEGER NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quotes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "business_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES businesses (id), "customer_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "invoice_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "invoice_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "invoice_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "supply_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "place_of_supply" INTEGER NOT NULL, "subtotal" REAL NOT NULL, "discount_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "taxable_amount" REAL NOT NULL, "cgst_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "sgst_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "igst_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "cess_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "total_amount" REAL NOT NULL, "round_off_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "amount_in_words" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "terms" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT', "is_igst" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_igst" IN (0, 1)), "template_id" INTEGER NULL, "reverse_charge" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reverse_charge" IN (0, 1)), "ship_to_name" TEXT NULL, "ship_to_address" TEXT NULL, "ship_to_city" TEXT NULL, "export_with_lut" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("export_with_lut" IN (0, 1)), "tds_section" TEXT NULL, "tds_rate" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "tds_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "tcs_section" TEXT NULL, "tcs_rate" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "tcs_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("business_id", "invoice_number"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quote_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "quote_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES quotes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "product_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES products (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "hsn_sac" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" REAL NOT NULL, "rate" REAL NOT NULL, "discount_pct" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "taxable_amount" REAL NOT NULL, "gst_rate" REAL NOT NULL, "cgst_rate" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "sgst_rate" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "igst_rate" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "cess_rate" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "cgst_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "sgst_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "igst_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "cess_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "total_amount" REAL NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hsn_codes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "gst_rate" REAL NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'HSN');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hsn_code_rates" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "gst_rate" REAL NULL, "effective_from" INTEGER NOT NULL, "min_unit_price" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "max_unit_price" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000000000000.0, UNIQUE ("code", "effective_from", "min_unit_price", "max_unit_price"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "uoms" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "family" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GENERAL', "base_code" TEXT NULL, "conversion_factor" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "template_configs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "business_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES businesses (id), "scope" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "config_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "document_sequences" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "business_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES businesses (id), "doc_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "fiscal_year" TEXT NOT NULL, "format" TEXT NOT NULL, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, UNIQUE ("business_id", "doc_type", "fiscal_year", "format"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_movements" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "quantity_delta" REAL NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "document_type" TEXT NULL, "document_id" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_invoices" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "business_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES businesses (id), "source_invoice_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices (id), "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MONTHLY', "next_run_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
